Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money and currency to be transferred when a payment instruction is created as a result of a standing order.

Creditor.name: Creditor
Creditor.definition: Party to which an amount of money is due.

CreditorAccount.name: Creditor Account
CreditorAccount.definition: Cash account credited from a standing order mechanism.

Debtor.name: Debtor
Debtor.definition: Party that owes an amount of money to the (ultimate) creditor.

DebtorAccount.name: Debtor Account
DebtorAccount.definition: Cash account debited from a standing order mechanism.

ExecutionType.name: Execution Type
ExecutionType.definition: Defines whether the standing order is executed through a time-based or an event-based trigger.

Frequency.name: Frequency
Frequency.definition: Regularity with which payment instructions are to be created and processed as a result of the standing order, such as daily, weekly, or monthly.

ValidityPeriod.name: Validity Period
ValidityPeriod.definition: Dates during which the standing order is in effect.

ZeroSweepIndicator.name: Zero Sweep Indicator
ZeroSweepIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the standing order is defined as a zero sweeping order. When true, the liquidity transfer standing order will transfer all amount of money out of the account so the resulting balance is zero.

ModifyStandingOrderValueSetRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
